name: Travellers Among Mountains
dimensions: Height 33.5 cm; Length 61 cm; Height 41 cm; Length 66 cm
summary: Unlike the works in his typical style, this painting by Zhou Chen (c.1450 - 1535) employs bolder and looser brushwork, suggesting that it was made by this Suzhou artist in his late years. The sketchy strokes depict a man on horseback accompanied by his assistants, travelling on a precipitous mountai
